story:
“Garf, could you do me a favor and taste-test this again?”

With that, Petra made her request, and Garfiel scratched his head with a reluctant air, saying, “Well, ain’t got much choice, huh?”

How many times had it been now that Petra had asked him to be her taste-tester like this? Every day, determined not to lose to her sister Frederica, Petra honed her cooking skills, and she often turned to Garfiel as the practice dummy to show off her flavors to.

Apparently, since Subaru—her intended audience—and Garfiel had similar tastes, he was just the right guy for the job. For Garfiel, it was a chance to snag some extra grub beyond the usual three squares, and since even her experimental dishes were plenty tasty, he was all in for taste-testing duty.

Still, he’d put on a bit of a show just now partly because Otto had been drilling into him lately that nothing should be given away cheap.

“Listen up, Garfiel. There’s such a thing as limits. If you let yourself get undervalued, then the people who rely on you get undervalued too. Keep that in mind.”

That was the gist of it.

Honestly, Garfiel hated the idea of Subaru or Emilia getting shortchanged. So he figured he’d try putting it into practice as much as he could—though who knew if it was working.

“Heh, what’s that about? Did Otto say something to you again?”

“Hah? How’d ya guess? Ah! Unless it’s that? Ya think I’m startin’ to look like Brother Otto or somethin’?”

“Nope, not at all.”

“Oh... right...”

“Why’re you getting all down about it already? Garf has tons of great qualities just being himself, so you shouldn’t go thinking you wanna be like Otto or anything.”

“But the boss and Brother Otto are both so damn cool, y’know!”

Garfiel’s shoulders slumped in defeat, and Petra let out a small, exasperated chuckle.

“You were wondering how I knew, right? But whenever Garf acts different from usual, it’s either him imitating Subaru or after Otto’s said something to him, y’know? And I can tell those apart from when he’s just trying to play it cool versus when he’s being serious.”

“Hah~, I see... But that whole ‘not selling myself short’ vibe I was going for just now—ain’t that kinda like playing it cool too?”

“Yeah. But it doesn’t feel like you’re imitating Subaru, does it? Subaru wouldn’t pull something like that.”

As expected from the girl whose eye for aesthetics was second only to Ram’s in the mansion—her judgment was sharp. Garfiel had thought the same while saying it himself: that lofty act didn’t really feel like Subaru.

Anyway—

“I ain’t sellin’ myself short or nothin’, so don’t go tattlin’ to Brother Otto, got it?”

“As if I would. I’m the one asking you to taste-test, after all. Today I tried making the barbaro rabbit a little sweet-and-sour. It’s my masterpiece!”

“Sweet stuff ain’t exactly your strong suit, is it?”

“That’s why I wanna nail that tricky line. Here, I’ll knock your socks off.”

Petra puffed out her chest with confidence, and right then—between lunch and dinner—Garfiel’s stomach let out a little growl as his appetite kicked in. He patted it once and gnashed his teeth.

There was a lot Garfiel could learn from Petra’s drive. Since she was close to him in age, her relentless push from below often lit a fire under him.

For the moment, at least—

“Guess I’ll have to put that masterpiece of yours to the test with my tongue, then.”

He clapped his fist against his palm in front of his chest as he said it, though Garfiel was well aware this was a losing battle. After all, Petra had knocked him flat on his ass like this plenty of times before.

—So, in the end, how’d it turn out?

“Huh. Petra’s new creation today, eh? The last one was crazy good too. But honestly, my tongue’s getting spoiled. Don’t think I’ll go down that easy... Ohhh, it’s goooood!!”

“Honestly, Subaru, you’re way too extra, and it’s so predictable. If you just roll over and admit defeat like that, Petra might get complacent with where she’s at. So here, Betty’s gonna have to toughen up and... Eeeeek, it’s amaaaazing!!”

Faced with the dish in question, Subaru and Beatrice took a bite in sync and went wild with excitement. Petra beamed at the sight, while Garfiel clicked his teeth in satisfaction at the results. And so, the cook and her taste-tester quietly bumped fists in a high-five.

~Fin~
